items.title: Rusty Dedrick interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: Dick Hyman and I became friends... But then we became such friends that he had me on his dates and vice versa

ctx.x: So how were you able to carve out your own niche in New York City after?
Okay I got a name, it’s the name number one on your list of honorees on the paper you sent me — Dick Hyman.
